answer: Sybil resistance follows from binding each agent to a recursive ZK reputation commitment that absorbs all proof hashes into one succinct root, while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces sequential work before any identity branch can emit a plausible plume of attestations. Collateral staked per leaf and slashed for forked proofs makes cloning cost linear in depth; if a glacier of stale commitments remains unpruned, inlet to fresh stake is blocked until slashing recovers the public ledger, giving negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium.
